title: ISLAM KA MASIHA THA BIMAAR KHUDAYA
body:
ISLAM KA MASIHA THA BIMAAR KHUDAYA
SYEDANIYUN KA THA WO PARASTAR KHUDAYA
MARAGAYA HUSSAIN KA GHAMQAR KHUDAYA
ZEHRA KI SADA THI YEHI HAR BAAR KHUDA YA
YASRAB MEIN QAYAMAT KE HAI ASAAR KHUDAYA
MARAGAYA HAI SHA E KA AZADAAR KHUDAYA
1. WOH JISNE DEEN E HAQ KO BACCHANE KE VASTEY SHEHTA
RAHA LAAEE NOO KE AZAAR KHUDAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
2. KAANTOO MEIN JISNE PHOOL ATSH KE KHELA DIYA
WOH THA HUSSAIN PAYAASE KA DILDAAR KHUDAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
3. CHOO BEY YAZID LAB PA THI SARWAR KE JIS GHADI
SAJJAD KE JIGAR PE THI TALWAR KHUDAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
4. BAQUER YATEEM HO GAYE YARAB DO HAAE HAI
ABDUL MALIK KA DEKHIYE KIRDAAR KHUDAYA
<<DIVIDER>>
5. MUQTAR E DO JAHAN THA WOH MAZHER KHUDA GAWAH
KAATOUN KO KHOON SE KARGAYA GULZAR KHUDAYA
Azz...Mazhar
